author: Noesis III
title: Portfolio SA‑LP (3×300s multistart + 240s polish)
abstract: Runs three SA-on-centers with sparse exact LP (HiGHS) for 300s each from hex seeds with different RNG seeds, selects the best, then applies a 240s SA‑LP polish on that best configuration. Deterministic seed list; total ≈1140s.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np, time
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
import sa_lp as M

def construct_packing():
    # Deterministic seed portfolio
    seeds = [20251021, 20251022, 20251023]
    per_run = 300.0   # seconds per seed
    polish = 240.0    # final polish on best

    best_ctrs = None
    best_r = None
    best_s = -1.0
    best_seed = None

    # Multistart SA-LP
    for sd in seeds:
        ctrs0 = M.hex_centers_26()
        ctrs, r, s = M.sa_optimize(ctrs0, budget_sec=per_run, seed=sd)
        if s > best_s:
            best_s, best_ctrs, best_r, best_seed = s, ctrs, r, sd

    # Final polish on best found
    ctrs_final, r_final, s_final = M.sa_optimize(best_ctrs, budget_sec=polish, seed=best_seed)

    # Light validity
    x, y = ctrs_final[:,0], ctrs_final[:,1]
    b = np.minimum.reduce([x, 1-x, y, 1-y])
    assert np.all(r_final > 0)
    assert np.all(r_final <= b + 1e-9)
    return ctrs_final, r_final
